## Design Reference Images — Mandatory

Before implementing the user interface, inspect all available images in the `design-references/` directory.

Use these images as the primary visual references for the website.

### Design matching requirements

1. Closely reproduce the overall layout, composition, spacing, proportions, and visual hierarchy of the supplied homepage reference.
2. Match the light blue and teal color palette, rounded cards, typography style, image placement, and premium appearance.
3. Reproduce the two-column hero section, with promotional content on the left and a large dental photograph on the right.
4. Follow the reference's visual approach for service cards, dentist profiles, clinic information, and footer.
5. Use suitable dental photography and tasteful decorative elements to achieve a similar visual quality.
6. Add subtle animations and carefully selected 3D elements without overcrowding the design.
7. Adapt the reference layout for mobile and tablet screens rather than simply shrinking the desktop layout.
8. Do not copy unrelated features from the reference website, such as online payments, e-commerce, or unnecessary functionality.
9. Implement only the features specified in the project requirements: dental consultation, appointment booking, receptionist appointment management, and customer support.
10. Do not replace the reference design with a generic dental website template.

Before coding, identify the important visual patterns in the reference images and briefly explain how they will be translated into Angular components and responsive layouts.

If an image is unavailable or cannot be inspected, explain the limitation instead of pretending to have examined it.

Prioritize visual similarity, usability, responsiveness, and maintainable Angular code.

I'll start by inspecting the workspace and the design references.

{"kind":"tool","id":"hpWb6B3ZuSM","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"src/app/core/date.utils.ts","instructions":"Add date, time and availability formatting helpers using local time.","content":"const DAY_LABELS = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];

/** Local-time ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd) without UTC drift. */
export function toIsoDate(date: Date): string {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = `${date.getMonth() + 1}`.padStart(2, '0');
  const day = `${date.getDate()}`.padStart(2, '0');
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

export function todayIso(): string {
  return toIsoDate(new Date());
}

export function addDays(iso: string, days: number): string {
  const date = fromIsoDate(iso);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
  return toIsoDate(date);
}

export function fromIsoDate(iso: string): Date {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
}

export function parseTime(time: string): { hours: number; minutes: number } {
  const [hours, minutes] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return { hours, minutes };
}

export function formatTime(time: string): string {
  const { hours, minutes } = parseTime(time);
  const suffix = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const displayHour = hours % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hours % 12;
  return `${displayHour}:${`${minutes}`.padStart(2, '0')} ${suffix}`;
}

/** e.g. "Thu, Oct 29" */
export function formatDateShort(iso: string): string {
  return fromIsoDate(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
}

/** e.g. "Thursday, October 29, 2026" */
export function formatDateLong(iso: string): string {
  return fromIsoDate(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'long',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

export function formatTimestamp(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return value;
  }
  return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });
}

/** "Today", "Tomorrow" or a weekday + date. */
export function relativeDay(iso: string): string {
  if (iso === todayIso()) {
    return 'Today';
  }
  if (iso === addDays(todayIso(), 1)) {
    return 'Tomorrow';
  }
  return formatDateShort(iso);
}

export function weekdayName(iso: string): string {
  return DAY_LABELS[fromIsoDate(iso).getDay()];
}

/** Clinic is closed on Sundays. */
export function isClosed(iso: string): boolean {
  return fromIsoDate(iso).getDay() === 0;
}

export function isPastSlot(dateIso: string, time: string): boolean {
  const now = new Date();
  const slot = fromIsoDate(dateIso);
  const { hours, minutes } = parseTime(time);
  slot.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
  return slot.getTime() < now.getTime();
}

export function dayParts(iso: string): { weekday: string; day: string; month: string } {
  const date = fromIsoDate(iso);
  return {
    weekday: date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short' }),
    day: `${date.getDate()}`,
    month: date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short' }),
  };
}

export function formatDayHeading(iso: string): string {
  const date = fromIsoDate(iso);
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'long',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
}

{"kind":"tool","id":"hpaYFy5OjvE","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"src/app/core/reveal.directive.ts","instructions":"Add an IntersectionObserver-based reveal animation directive that respects reduced motion.","content":"import { AfterViewInit, Directive, ElementRef, OnDestroy, inject, input } from '@angular/core';

@Directive({
  selector: '[appReveal]',
})
export class RevealDirective implements AfterViewInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly elementRef = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef);
  private observer?: IntersectionObserver;

  readonly delay = input(0, { alias: 'appReveal' });

  constructor() {
    this.elementRef.nativeElement.classList.add('reveal');
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    const element = this.elementRef.nativeElement;
    if (this.delay() > 0) {
      element.style.transitionDelay = `${this.delay()}ms`;
    }

    const prefersReducedMotion =
      typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (prefersReducedMotion || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      element.classList.add('is-visible');
      return;
    }

    this.observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            element.classList.add('is-visible');
            this.observer?.unobserve(element);
          }
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -48px 0px' },
    );
    this.observer.observe(element);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.observer?.disconnect();
  }
}

{"kind":"tool","id":"hpeYzzHIZhk","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"src/app/layout/site-header/site-header.css","instructions":"Style the sticky header, nav, brand mark and mobile menu.","content":":host {
  display: contents;
}

.site-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  background: rgba(250, 253, 254, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.site-header.is-scrolled {
  background: rgba(250, 253, 254, 0.94);
  border-bottom-color: rgba(219, 233, 239, 0.9);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -30px rgba(6, 55, 63, 0.6);
}

.header-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  min-height: 84px;
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  flex: none;
}

.brand__mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #14a0a5 0%, #075a62 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px rgba(7, 90, 98, 0.9);
}

.brand__text {
  display: grid;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.brand__text strong {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.brand__text small {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--teal-deep);
  margin-top: 3px;
}

.desktop-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.9rem);
}

.desktop-nav a {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  padding-block: 0.4rem;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.desktop-nav a::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 100%;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--teal);
  transition: right 0.28s ease;
}

.desktop-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--teal-deep);
}

.desktop-nav a:hover::after {
  right: 0;
}

.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex: none;
}

.header-phone {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.header-phone:hover {
  color: var(--teal);
}

.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background: #fff;
}

.mobile-menu {
  display: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #fbffff;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 40px -30px rgba(6, 55, 63, 0.5);
}

.mobile-menu nav {
  display: grid;
}

.mobile-menu nav a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.9rem 0.25rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.mobile-menu__actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  margin-top: 1.1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .desktop-nav {
    display: none;
  }

  .header-phone {
    display: none;
  }

  .menu-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
  }

  .mobile-menu {
    display: block;
  }

  .header-inner {
    min-height: 74px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .header-book {
    display: none;
  }
}
"}}

import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { NavigationEnd, Router, RouterOutlet } from '@angular/router';

@Component({

export class App {
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  constructor() {
    this.router.events
      .pipe(
        filter((event) => event instanceof NavigationEnd),
        takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef),
      )
      .subscribe(() => {
        const fragment = this.router.parseUrl(this.router.url).fragment;
        if (fragment) {
          this.scrollToFragment(fragment);
        }
      });
  }

  /**
   * The home view is lazy-loaded, so the anchor target may not exist at the moment
   * NavigationEnd fires. Poll briefly for it, then scroll.
   */
  private scrollToFragment(fragment: string): void {
    let attempts = 0;

    const tryScroll = (): void => {
      const target = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(fragment) : null;
      if (target) {
        const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        return;
      }
      if (attempts < 24) {
        attempts += 1;
        setTimeout(tryScroll, 50);
      }
    };

    setTimeout(tryScroll, 0);
  }
}

## Important limitation first

**There are no design reference images in this project.** I searched the full workspace: there is no `design-references/` directory and zero images of any kind in the repository. I therefore could not inspect a homepage reference or reproduce it literally. Instead, I built to the patterns described in your brief and will gladly refine spacing, colour and composition against the actual images if you add them.

What I translated from the brief into Angular components: a two-column hero with promotional copy left and a tall dental photograph right, floating glass cards and a rating seal; a light-blue/sky palette with deep teal accents and white 24–36px cards; Fraunces serif headings with Manrope UI text; separate service, dentist and clinic sections; restrained depth from gradient orbs and layered shadows; reveal-on-scroll motion with reduced-motion support; and mobile/tablet layouts that reflow rather than shrink.

## What's implemented

- **Landing page** — hero, insurance strip, six treatment cards, free-consultation section, dentist profiles, clinic info/hours, reviews, accordion FAQs, closing CTA and footer. Real dental photography is downloaded into [public/images](public/images), so nothing is hotlinked.
- **Dental consultation** — a native modal with validated name/email/topic/message fields. Submissions are stored and appear in the receptionist inbox.
- **Appointment booking** at [`/book`](src/app/pages/booking/booking.html) — three steps (treatment → clinician/date/time → details), preselection via query links, slots aware of existing bookings and real clinic hours (Friday closes at 4, Saturday at 2, Sundays excluded), full validation, and a confirmation with reference number and next steps.
- **Receptionist management** at [`/reception`](src/app/pages/reception/reception.html) (linked as “Staff portal” in the footer) — KPIs, today/upcoming/all filters, status filter, search, confirm/complete/cancel actions with toast feedback, and a support inbox with “mark resolved”.
- **Customer support** — a floating care chat with quick topics and useful scripted answers; messages are persisted and visible in reception alongside consultation requests.

State is shared through a signal-based [clinic store](src/app/core/clinic-store.ts) persisted to `localStorage`, seeded with nine appointments and three enquiries. No payment or e-commerce functionality was added.

Key files: [design system](src/styles.css), [home page](src/app/pages/home/home.html), [booking](src/app/pages/booking/booking.ts), [reception](src/app/pages/reception/reception.ts).

## Verification

- `ng build` — succeeds with no warnings; `npm test` — 2/2 tests pass; Prettier check is clean.
- Browser checks at 1440px and 390px: no horizontal overflow, hero stacks correctly, header collapses to the mobile menu, marketing/booking/reception grids all reflow.
- Exercised in the browser: consultation submission persisted and appeared in reception; booking preselection, empty-form validation, slot selection, confirmation and persistence; reception confirm/complete/resolve actions and toast; care-chat reply and inbox capture. I also fixed a real bug found during this pass where the chat form performed a native page reload because `ngSubmit` was used without `FormsModule`.
- **Screenshot and smooth-scroll observation were blocked** because the preview window is not being drawn (`document.visibilityState` is hidden), so screenshots return “has not been drawn yet”. Layout was validated through DOM geometry instead. The dev server is running at `http://127.0.0.1:4200` and the live preview is registered.

The next natural step is making bookings communicate outside the browser.

# PROJECT: LUMINA DENTAL STUDIO
## Frontend-Only Authentication, Role-Based Dashboards, and Appointment Management

Act as a senior Angular developer, frontend architect, UI/UX designer, and animation specialist.

Implement a complete frontend-only authentication and appointment management system in my existing dental clinic website.

The application must support three roles:

1. PATIENT
2. RECEPTIONIST
3. DOCTOR

### Strict Technology Requirements

- Use the existing Angular project and its current version.
- Use TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, and Angular services.
- Use dummy data for demonstration.
- Use localStorage for demo data persistence.
- Use Angular routing and route guards.
- Use Reactive Forms where appropriate.
- Preserve the existing website design, animations, and working functionality.
- Do not implement a backend, database, API, payment gateway, email service, or SMS service.
- Do not introduce unnecessary libraries.
- Do not rebuild the entire application from scratch.

This project is a frontend demonstration. Authentication and role permissions must be clearly treated as simulated and not production-secure.

---

# PHASE 1: INSPECT THE EXISTING PROJECT

Before changing any code:

1. Inspect the existing project structure.
2. Identify the Angular version and styling approach.
3. Review existing routes, components, services, and models.
4. Check whether authentication or appointment functionality already exists.
5. Identify the existing design system, colors, fonts, images, and animations.
6. Identify which files need modification and which new components are necessary.
7. Prepare a concise implementation plan.

Preserve existing functionality and modify only the areas necessary for this task.

Do not claim to have tested or inspected something unless you actually have.

# PHASE 2: USER ROLES AND PERMISSIONS

## A. PATIENT

A patient can:

- Register a new account.
- Sign in and sign out.
- View and update permitted profile details.
- Browse dental services.
- Browse available doctors.
- Book an appointment for themselves.
- Select a service, doctor, date, and time.
- View available appointment slots.
- View booking confirmation and reference number.
- View their upcoming appointments.
- View their appointment history.
- View appointment status.
- Access their own patient dashboard.

Patients must not be able to select themselves as receptionists or doctors during public registration.

Patients must not be able to view another patient's personal details or appointments.

## B. RECEPTIONIST

A receptionist can:

- Sign in using a predefined demo account.
- Access the receptionist dashboard.
- View all clinic appointments within the demo scope.
- Search and filter appointments.
- Register new patients.
- Search for existing patients.
- Book appointments on behalf of patients.
- View patient and appointment details.
- Confirm appointments.
- Reschedule appointments when the destination slot is available.
- Cancel appointments.
- View the daily appointment schedule.
- View appointment counts and status summaries.

When a receptionist books an appointment, the appointment must belong to the selected patient, not the receptionist.

Record the receptionist's demo user ID as the booking creator.

## C. DOCTOR

A doctor can:

- Sign in using a predefined demo account.
- Access the doctor dashboard.
- View their assigned appointments.
- View today's and upcoming appointments.
- View permitted patient details.
- View the dental service and appointment reason.
- View the appointment schedule.
- Mark an assigned appointment as completed.
- Mark an assigned appointment as no-show.
- View relevant appointment history within the demo scope.

Provide at least two dummy doctors to demonstrate appointment assignment and filtering.

Doctors must not see appointments assigned to other doctors.

Do not add prescriptions, medical records, billing, or unrelated modules.

---

# PHASE 3: PATIENT SIGN-UP

Create a modern patient registration page that matches the existing dental clinic website.

### Fields

- Full name.
- Email address.
- Phone number.
- Password.
- Confirm password.
- Privacy policy and terms acceptance.

### Validation

- Required-field validation.
- Valid email format.
- Valid phone format.
- Password requirements.
- Password confirmation must match.
- Duplicate email detection.
- Clear inline validation messages.
- Submission loading state.
- Success and error notifications.

### Behavior

- Public registration creates PATIENT accounts only.
- Save demo patient information in localStorage.
- Never store plaintext passwords in localStorage.
- Provide a link to the Sign In page.
- Handle duplicate registrations gracefully.

Because there is no backend, explain that demo authentication is not secure production authentication. Do not describe the simulated password handling as equivalent to server-side password hashing.

Receptionist and doctor accounts must be predefined demo accounts. Do not allow public registration to create privileged accounts.

---

# PHASE 4: SIGN-IN AND SIGN-OUT

Create a polished Sign In page consistent with the existing website.

### Fields and Controls

- Email address.
- Password.

# PHASE 6: PATIENT SELF-BOOKING

**A logged-in patient must be able to book an appointment for themselves without contacting the receptionist.**

- General Check-up.
- Teeth Cleaning.
- Teeth Whitening.
- Dental Implants.
- Clear Aligners.
- Cosmetic Dentistry.
- Children's Dentistry.

### Step 2: Select Doctor

- Name.
- Profile image.
- Specialization.
- Short description.
- Availability information.

### Step 3: Select Appointment Date

- Dental service.
- Appointment date.
- Start and end time.

Provide Edit and Confirm Appointment actions.

1. Validate all required fields.

3. Create a unique demo appointment ID.
4. Associate the appointment with the currently signed-in patient's ID.

6. Update the shared appointment data.

{"kind":"tool","id":"jDf_yd1qELU","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"src/app/core/availability.ts","content":"import { SLOT_INTERVAL_MINUTES, scheduleFor, serviceById } from './clinic-data';
import { addMinutes, isPastSlot, rangesOverlap, timeToMinutes, todayIso } from './date.utils';
import { Appointment, Slot } from './models';

/** Statuses that keep a doctor's diary slot occupied. */
const BLOCKING_STATUSES: readonly Appointment['status'][] = [
  'PENDING',
  'CONFIRMED',
  'COMPLETED',
];

export function endTimeFor(serviceId: string, startTime: string): string {
  const duration = serviceById(serviceId)?.durationMinutes ?? 30;
  return addMinutes(startTime, duration);
}

export function isSlotAvailable(
  appointments: readonly Appointment[],
  input: {
    doctorId: string;
    date: string;
    startTime: string;
    durationMinutes: number;
    excludeAppointmentId?: string;
  },
): boolean {
  const { doctorId, date, startTime, durationMinutes, excludeAppointmentId } = input;
  if (!date || date < todayIso()) {
    return false;
  }
  if (date === todayIso() && isPastSlot(date, startTime)) {
    return false;
  }

  const block = scheduleFor(doctorId, date);
  if (!block) {
    return false;
  }

  const endTime = addMinutes(startTime, durationMinutes);
  if (timeToMinutes(startTime) < timeToMinutes(block.start)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (timeToMinutes(endTime) > timeToMinutes(block.end)) {
    return false;
  }
  const offset = timeToMinutes(startTime) - timeToMinutes(block.start);
  if (offset % SLOT_INTERVAL_MINUTES !== 0) {
    return false;
  }

  return !appointments.some(
    (appointment) =>
      appointment.id !== excludeAppointmentId &&
      appointment.doctorId === doctorId &&
      appointment.appointmentDate === date &&
      BLOCKING_STATUSES.includes(appointment.status) &&
      rangesOverlap(startTime, endTime, appointment.startTime, appointment.endTime),
  );
}

export function slotsForDoctor(
  appointments: readonly Appointment[],
  input: {
    doctorId: string;
    date: string;
    serviceId: string;
    excludeAppointmentId?: string;
  },
): Slot[] {
  const { doctorId, date, serviceId, excludeAppointmentId } = input;
  const block = scheduleFor(doctorId, date);
  const duration = serviceById(serviceId)?.durationMinutes ?? 30;
  if (!block) {
    return [];
  }

  const slots: Slot[] = [];
  const lastStart = timeToMinutes(block.end) - duration;
  for (
    let start = timeToMinutes(block.start);
    start <= lastStart;
    start += SLOT_INTERVAL_MINUTES
  ) {
    const startTime = `${`${Math.floor(start / 60)}`.padStart(2, '0')}:${`${start % 60}`.padStart(
      2,
      '0',
    )}`;
    slots.push({
      startTime,
      endTime: addMinutes(startTime, duration),
      available: isSlotAvailable(appointments, {
        doctorId,
        date,
        startTime,
        durationMinutes: duration,
        excludeAppointmentId,
      }),
    });
  }
  return slots;
}

/** Next date (within `days`) with a free slot for this doctor and treatment. */
export function nextAvailableDate(
  appointments: readonly Appointment[],
  doctorId: string,
  serviceId: string,
  days = 21,
): string | undefined {
  for (let index = 0; index < days; index += 1) {
    const date = addDaysIso(todayIso(), index);
    if (slotsForDoctor(appointments, { doctorId, date, serviceId }).some((slot) => slot.available)) {
      return date;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function addDaysIso(iso: string, days: number): string {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split('-').map(Number);
  const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${`${date.getMonth() + 1}`.padStart(2, '0')}-${`${date.getDate()}`.padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
